repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
fix a double free bug in AbstractNioByteChannel for Netty4.0+

Motivation:

see issue #3369 .  

Modifications:

Add a line of code in line 119
                        byteBuf = null;
to set byteBuf to null to avoid another byteBuf.release() to be called in handleReadException()

body: @normanmaurer the attempted fix doesn't seem to work; I'm still getting the error with http://clinker.netty.io/nexus/content/repositories/snapshots/io/netty/netty-all/4.0.26.Final-SNAPSHOT/netty-all-4.0.26.Final-20150201.085343-43.jar
Ah. I see where this went astray... Commit 14390be references this bug instead of #3369, which is what it actually fixes.  @SubJunk, that's why you're still getting the error.
@mfulgo yeah it looks like it. Really hoping this issue can be fixed before the next release :)
You guys are right. It's not fixed yet. We love contributions by the way. :-)

@trustin I wouldn't mind writing a patch, but I'm not sure I understand it well enough to do the right thing. Unfortunately, the `ChunkedInput` interface doesn't have an `.isClosed()` method, so you can't add a check for that in line 177 of `ChunkedWriteHandler`.  You could always specifically catch the IOException and match on the message, but that's almost always the wrong thing to do.
